title: Explainery story
description: One story.yaml per project. It owns all on-screen copy and narration, so the video, explainer page, and captions share one source.

theme.description: Theme directory in explainery-core/themes, for example "dark".

pronunciations.description: Spellings a synthetic draft voice speaks in place of a written word, for example "SQL": "S-Q-L". Whole, case-sensitive words; on-screen text, transcripts and recordings keep the written word.

voice.description: Settings `explainery voice` uses for the local synthetic voice when its command-line options do not name them. The language follows from the voice name.

name.description: Kokoro voice, for example "af_heart"; its first letter selects the language.

speed.description: Speaking rate; 1 is the voice's own pace.

gap.description: Seconds of silence added after each composition's hold minus overlap.

narration.description: Spoken text; {beat-id} markers name the beats that composition tweens anchor to.

hold.description: Seconds the composition stays after its narration ends.

overlap.description: Seconds of crossfade into the next composition.

card.description: Drawn by the theme's card layer instead of compositions/<id>.html. A chapter card opens its scene with the scene's number and title and this copy's headline as its question; an agenda card lists every scene title.

id.description: Identifies an editorial scene, independently of its compositions.
